name: reporter_cluster_heatmap_handbook
description: Heatmap reporter handbook: hm L1-L13 + cs L1-L8. 21 layouts testing diverse metrics, axis combos, aggregation modes, and styling.
source:
# ========================================================================
# Heatmap Family Handbook — All Layouts
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = market_data_source()()
open_px = src.o
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v
ts = index()

# === Core Derived Series ===
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)

# Date components
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)
dow = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)

# Monthly return proxy (month-end only, NaN elsewhere)
month_next = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month, timezone='America/New_York')(ts >> 1)
month_end = 1.0 if month_num != month_next else 0.0 / 0.0
monthly_ret = daily_ret * month_end
nan_flag = monthly_ret / monthly_ret
month_x = month_num * nan_flag
year_y = year_num * nan_flag

# Additional metrics (month-end snapshot)
vol_ratio = volume / sma(volume, 20)
monthly_vol_ratio = vol_ratio * month_end
daily_range_pct = (high - low) / close
monthly_range_pct = daily_range_pct * month_end
gap_pct = (open_px - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
monthly_gap_pct = gap_pct * month_end

# Quarter computation
qtr = 1.0 if month_num <= 3 else (2.0 if month_num <= 6 else (3.0 if month_num <= 9 else 4.0))
quarter_x = qtr * nan_flag

# ========================================================================
# HEATMAP (per-asset) — L1 through L11
# Diverse metrics, axis combos, and styling options
# ========================================================================

# L1: Monthly Returns Seasonality — classic use case
heatmap(
    title='L1: Monthly Returns Seasonality',
    category='01 hm L1: Monthly Returns',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.1f}%',
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green,
    x_axis_label='Month', y_axis_label='Year'
)(x=month_x, y=year_y, value=monthly_ret)

# L2: Weekday Effect — DayOfWeek x Month (daily data, last-value-per-cell)
# Tests y_category_type=DayOfWeek with daily granularity
heatmap(
    title='L2: Day-of-Week x Month Returns',
    category='02 hm L2: Weekday Effect',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green
)(x=month_num, y=dow, value=daily_ret)

# L3: Quarterly Returns — coarser seasonal view
heatmap(
    title='L3: Quarterly Returns Grid',
    category='03 hm L3: Quarterly View',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Quarter,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.1f}%',
    x_axis_label='Quarter', y_axis_label='Year'
)(x=quarter_x, y=year_y, value=monthly_ret)

# L4: Volume Intensity — non-return metric (volume vs 20d average)
heatmap(
    title='L4: Volume Intensity (vs 20d Avg)',
    category='04 hm L4: Volume Intensity',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    value_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.2f}',
    min_color=Color.Blue,
    max_color=Color.Red,
    x_axis_label='Month', y_axis_label='Year'
)(x=month_x, y=year_y, value=monthly_vol_ratio)

# L5: Intraday Range % — volatility seasonality (not returns)
heatmap(
    title='L5: Daily Range % Seasonality',
    category='05 hm L5: Range Volatility',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.2f}%',
    min_color=Color.Green,
    max_color=Color.Red,
    x_axis_label='Month', y_axis_label='Year'
)(x=month_x, y=year_y, value=monthly_range_pct)

# L6: Compact Grid — DayOfWeek x Quarter (daily data)
heatmap(
    title='L6: Weekday x Quarter Returns',
    category='06 hm L6: DayOfWeek x Quarter',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Quarter,
    y_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green
)(x=qtr, y=dow, value=daily_ret)

# L7: Overnight Gap — open vs previous close seasonality
heatmap(
    title='L7: Overnight Gap % by Month',
    category='07 hm L7: Overnight Gaps',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.2f}%',
    min_color=Color.Blue,
    max_color=Color.Orange,
    x_axis_label='Month', y_axis_label='Year'
)(x=month_x, y=year_y, value=monthly_gap_pct)

# L8: Raw Numeric Grid — Exact axes, no category formatting
heatmap(
    title='L8: Raw Numeric Grid (Exact Axes)',
    category='08 hm L8: Exact Axes',
    x_axis_label='Month Number', y_axis_label='Year'
)(x=month_x, y=year_y, value=monthly_ret)

# L9: Color Axis Clamping — fixed range clips outliers
heatmap(
    title='L9: Returns Clamped to +/-3%',
    category='09 hm L9: Clamped Range',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    color_axis_min=-3.0,
    color_axis_max=3.0,
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green
)(x=month_x, y=year_y, value=monthly_ret)

# L10: Custom Color Stops — 3-point diverging gradient
heatmap(
    title='L10: Custom Gradient (Red-White-Blue)',
    category='10 hm L10: Color Stops',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    color_stops=ColorStopSchema(stops=[
        ColorStop(value=0.0, color=Color.Red),
        ColorStop(value=0.5, color=Color.White),
        ColorStop(value=1.0, color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x=month_x, y=year_y, value=monthly_ret)

# L11: Styling Showcase — borders, no labels, null color, custom palette
heatmap(
    title='L11: Styling (Borders + No Labels + Null Color)',
    category='11 hm L11: Styling',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    show_data_labels=False,
    border_width=3,
    border_color=Color.White,
    null_color=Color.Gray,
    min_color=Color.Indigo,
    max_color=Color.Amber
)(x=month_x, y=year_y, value=monthly_ret)

# L12: Frequency / Win-Rate Heatmap — agg=Mean on 0/1 indicator
# Tests the new aggregation feature: multiple daily rows per (month, year)
# cell are aggregated automatically. win=1.0 when daily return is positive.
win_indicator = 1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='L12: Daily Win Rate by Month x Year',
    category='12 hm L12: Frequency (agg=Mean)',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.1f}%',
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green,
    color_axis_min=0.0,
    color_axis_max=100.0,
    x_axis_label='Month', y_axis_label='Year'
)(x=month_num, y=year_num, value=win_indicator)

# L13: Observation Count Heatmap — agg=Count
# Shows how many trading days fall in each (month, year) cell.
# Useful for data coverage checks and sample size validation.
obs_flag = where(is_valid(close), 1.0)

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    title='L13: Trading Days per Month x Year',
    category='13 hm L13: Count (agg=Count)',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    x_axis_label='Month', y_axis_label='Year',
    min_color=Color.White,
    max_color=Color.Blue
)(x=month_num, y=year_num, value=obs_flag)

# ========================================================================
# CS_HEATMAP (cross-sectional) — L1 through L8
# Diverse aggregation types and styling
# ========================================================================

# CS L1: Correlation Matrix — pairwise Pearson correlations
cs_heatmap(
    title='CS L1: Return Correlation Matrix',
    category='14 cs L1: Correlation',
    mode=HeatmapMode.correlation,
    color_axis_min=-1.0,
    color_axis_max=1.0,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.2f}'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L2: Values — Last Close (price snapshot across assets)
cs_heatmap(
    title='CS L2: Last Close Price',
    category='15 cs L2: Last Price',
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Last
)(close)

# CS L3: Values — Mean Return (average daily return comparison)
cs_heatmap(
    title='CS L3: Mean Daily Return',
    category='16 cs L3: Mean Return',
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.3f}%'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L4: Values — Std Dev (volatility ranking across assets)
cs_heatmap(
    title='CS L4: Return Volatility (Std Dev)',
    category='17 cs L4: Volatility',
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Std,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.3f}%'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L5: Values — Min (worst single-day return per asset)
cs_heatmap(
    title='CS L5: Worst Daily Return',
    category='18 cs L5: Worst Day',
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Min,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.2f}%',
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green
)(daily_ret)

# CS L6: Values — Median (robust central tendency)
cs_heatmap(
    title='CS L6: Median Daily Return',
    category='19 cs L6: Median Return',
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.4f}%'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L7: Max Assets = 2 (filtered subset of correlation)
cs_heatmap(
    title='CS L7: Correlation (Max 2 Assets)',
    category='20 cs L7: Max Assets',
    mode=HeatmapMode.correlation,
    max_assets=2,
    color_axis_min=-1.0,
    color_axis_max=1.0
)(daily_ret)

# CS L8: Custom Color Stops on correlation
cs_heatmap(
    title='CS L8: Correlation (Custom Gradient)',
    category='21 cs L8: Color Stops',
    mode=HeatmapMode.correlation,
    color_axis_min=-1.0,
    color_axis_max=1.0,
    color_stops=ColorStopSchema(stops=[
        ColorStop(value=0.0, color=Color.Red),
        ColorStop(value=0.5, color=Color.White),
        ColorStop(value=1.0, color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(daily_ret)

# ========================================================================
# HEATMAP — AGG DIVERSITY (15 values)
# ========================================================================

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    category='AD heatmap agg=Sum'
)(x=month_num, y=year_num, value=daily_ret)

heatmap(

heatmap(

heatmap(

heatmap(

heatmap(

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Any,

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.CountDistinct,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    category='AD heatmap agg=CountDistinct'

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Kurtosis,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    category='AD heatmap agg=Kurtosis'
)(x=month_num, y=year_num, value=daily_ret)

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Mode,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    category='AD heatmap agg=Mode'
)(x=month_num, y=year_num, value=daily_ret)

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Product,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    category='AD heatmap agg=Product'

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Quantile,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    category='AD heatmap agg=Quantile'

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Skew,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    category='AD heatmap agg=Skew'

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Var,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    category='AD heatmap agg=Var'
)(x=month_num, y=year_num, value=daily_ret)

# ========================================================================
# CS_HEATMAP — AGG DIVERSITY (13 values)
# ========================================================================

cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    category='AD cs_heatmap agg=Sum'
)(daily_ret)

cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,

cs_heatmap(

cs_heatmap(

    category='AD cs_heatmap agg=First'

cs_heatmap(
